summary_oneline: Self-contained E2E example: agent-built A2UI v1.0 linked-surface dashboard (KPIs, bar/pie charts, paged grid) over polestar_graduates_directory, with per-widget deterministic QuerySource refresh in an echarts + grid.js HTML5 renderer

localization.role: composes a multi-component linked createSurface (500-row snapshot cap)
agent tool qs_build_linked_surface — one component per call
persisted-surface routes incl. POST /api/v1/ui/surfaces/{id}/refresh (Postgres store, needs dataplane guard)
only client-side descriptor executor (TS); exposes refreshAll, runSource internal
Chart→ECharts option mapper; pie slices lack names
precedent: QuerySource(lazy=False).setup + BotManager + AuthHandler mount order

claims.claim: A linked surface is a v1.0 createSurface with metadata.extensions.parrot_data_sources keyed by dataModel root; components bind by path only
Only Chart, DataTable, KPICard are linkable; pie = Chart type=pie
Only TOOL-origin output may carry descriptors (LLM-authored rejected)
No helper composes a multi-widget linked dashboard from the agent side; qs_build_linked_surface builds one component
Browser refresh contract = POST {conditions, querylimit<=5000} to /api/v3/queries/{slug} (or /api/v1/{tenant}/queries/{slug}) with bearer token; no per-widget endpoint exists
The v3 multi-query handler accepts a single slug with fields/filter/group_by conditions (payload becomes slug conditions)
JSONB @> filter requires querysource>=5.1.0; shared .venv has 5.0.0 and core ai-parrot[db] pins >=4.1.11
Multi-graduate KPI expressible via fields: count(*) FILTER (WHERE jsonb_array_length(graduation_details) > 1)
Count-by-course pie is NOT expressible against the base slug; needs a second slug (LATERAL jsonb_array_elements) or a multi-query tExplode pipeline
Slugs live in Postgres <schema>.queries; no file-based slug loading; polestar_graduates_directory location/SQL unverified
Runtime needs Postgres + Redis (QS import, sessions, slug cache); 'no external deps' = no code outside the workspace
AuthHandler login returns {token,...}; BasicAuth needs authdb Postgres users; NoAuth is the only DB-less backend
QS PBAC is enabled in env/.env; strict denial returns 404 without session/policy
No existing renderer uses echarts+grid.js or re-queries on refresh; Svelte LinkedLane never wires a refresh button and only exposes refreshAll
Fetch cap 5000 rows and snapshot cap 500 rows → the ~17.5k-row grid must page server-side (_limit/_offset + count)
examples/a2ui/*.py and *.html are gitignored (.gitignore:20,37) and need whitelisting
Python echarts mapper emits unnamed pie slices (bug)
Wire doc §3 contradicts code on route/querylimit

unknowns.question: How to source the count-by-course pie (second slug vs multi-query pipeline vs client-side)?
unknowns.user_answer: Slug adicional — the example seeds a second slug (e.g. polestar_graduates_by_course, CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements) via seed SQL / management PUT

unknowns.question: Which auth backend for the demo login?
unknowns.user_answer: BasicAuth real — AuthHandler BasicAuth against the existing authdb/auth.vw_users; JWT stored in localStorage

unknowns.question: How is the surface generated/served (agent via BotManager persisted surface vs example server builds it in-process)?
unknowns.user_answer: Agente + endpoint propio — an Agent with QuerysourceToolkit + a new multi-widget dashboard tool (TOOL-origin); server.py serves it at its own GET route and optionally exposes the agent via BotManager

unknowns.question: Scope of core changes vs example-only?
unknowns.user_answer: All four: multi-widget dashboard helper, pin querysource>=5.1.1, fix pie slices + wire doc, per-widget refresh in TS LinkedLane + vanilla-JS port for the example

unknowns.question: Grid 17k rows: server-side paging vs raising the cap?
unknowns.user_answer: Defaulted (not asked): server-side paging with _limit/_offset + count(*)

recommended_next_command.rationale: Contract is well localized (FEAT-598 is fresh and tested); remaining unknowns are design choices resolvable in Q&A, not research gaps.
